mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner ear was most worthwhile: the picture showed how moving fluid bends tiny hairs and changes signals sent to nerves.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the eardrums to the canals was clear but mostly straightforward assembly.

surprise.text: The tiny bones push on fluid in the inner ear; I hadn't connected the air vibrations to fluid movement before.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures showed where the parts connected, even if I couldn't explain every detail of how hearing cells work.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter because following movement from the eardrum to nerve signals made me curious about how another sense works.
